item.text: {"analysis":"The candidate succeeded: validation HR@10 increased from the reported parent value of 0.635 to 0.650 (+0.015, or 1.5 percentage points), meeting the experimental target of 0.645–0.655. The host completed 25 epochs and selected epoch 5. With parameter untying as the sole planned change, this result supports independently parameterized early and late transformations for this fixed setup; it does not establish robustness across seeds or identify a definitive bottleneck. No test metric was used.","code_summary":"Causal NextItNet with eight independent residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8], replacing four shared blocks applied eight times while preserving the receptive field. Each block retains two left-padded convolutions, LayerNorm, GELU, dropout, and learned per-channel residual scaling initialized to 0.1. Item and position embeddings, padding masks, final normalization, last-nonpadding selection, and tied-embedding scoring remain unchanged. Constants remain MAXLEN=128, HIDDEN_UNITS=64, NUM_BLOCKS=8, KERNEL_SIZE=3, DROPOUT_RATE=0.2, LR=0.001, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.0, and BATCH_SIZE=128. Training and evaluation remain owned by the frozen host."}
